metadata.article_title: Language to be used in Parliament

article.title: Language to be used in Parliament
article.content:
120Language to be used in Parliament



Article 120 · Part V · Procedure Generally


(1)Notwithstanding anything in Part XVII, but subject to the provisions of
                article 348, business in Parliament shall be transacted in Hindi or in English:

ProvisoProvided that the Chairman of the Council of States or
                Speaker of the House of the People, or person acting as such, as the case may be, may permit any member
                who cannot adequately express himself in Hindi or in English to address the House in his mother-tongue.
              

(2)Unless Parliament by law otherwise provides, this article shall, after the
                expiration of a period of fifteen years from the commencement of this Constitution, have effect as if
                the words “or in English” were omitted therefrom.
